newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shares edge up but trade remains slow.
newsitem.headline: Lima shares edge up but trade remains slow.

text.p: Lima stocks edged up slightly by the close in a slow session marked by moderate bargain-buying of blue-chip shares, brokers said.
"The session was very quiet. The rise is primarily a technical one due to the cheap prices of the leaders that have fallen in recent sessions," said Alex Balarin, of Macrovalores brokerage.
Analysts predicted a stable market with thin volume for Tuesday.
In Monday's session, the General Index gained 0.02 percent to 1,388 points while the blue-chip Selective Index advanced 0.70 percent to 1,968.7 points, according to preliminary market figures.

"The indices that gained most today were the public service sector, up 2.12 percent, followed by the industrial sector, up 1.39 percent and insurance, up 0.80 percent," said Alberto Coba, of Stock Market brokerage.
Total market volume was a low 22 million soles ($9 million) on 1,128 trades.
Among leaders, benchmark Telefonica del Peru gained 0.41 percent to 4.90 soles on 998,447 shares, while electricity company Edegel rose 3.33 percent to 1.24 soles on 426,082 shares.
Miner Southern Copper Corporation, however, bucked the trend to fall 4.34 percent to $14.10 on 4,875 shares.
